## How it works

- [statement] The DriftSurf study proposes a stable-state/reactive-state process to mitigate false positives from standalone drift detection. (low confidence) — https://proceedings.mlr.press/v139/tahmasbi21a.html · keywords: Sequential/Streaming Concept-Drift Detectors (DDM, EDDM, ADWIN, Page-Hinkley, CUSUM)
